findings.detail: せんせいが いった ように かいて ください is natural and means the same 'as the teacher said'; a learner writing ように would be marked wrong.
findings.fix: Add ように to accepted, or tighten the hint to 'the word とおり + particle'.

findings.detail: With a communication verb like よぶ, ぶちょうから よばれました is also natural; から is a common way to mark the source in this passive.
かれが くるか、わかりません is natural and also means 'whether he will come'; a bare か fill is correct here.
findings.fix: Add か to accepted, or use a choose item where か is not an option.

use_tag_disagreements.why: emphasis is labeled 'Stressing how much or how little'; the のは ... です cleft spotlights a piece of information, not a quantity.
